P2para.Text: The 1989 Act is amended as follows.
In subsection (1) of section 25 (orders for securing compliance), for “and (5)” there is substituted “, (5) and (5A)”.
In subsection (5) of that section, paragraphs (b) and (c) shall cease to have effect.
After subsection (5) of that section there is inserted—
The Authority is not required to make a final order.

This Act (apart from this section and section 68) shall come into force on such day as the Secretary of State may by order made by statutory instrument appoint; and different days may be appointed for different purposes.

P1para.Text: In section 3 of the 1986 Act, after “the public” there is inserted “ and others”.
